```{python}
import json

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

# Include DataTables in the report itself, so it works offline
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=False)

# Written next to this document by script.py (see report_data.py)
with open("report_data.json") as f:
    D = json.load(f)
K = D["kpis"]

# Colors: up/down/not significant, and the condition groups (CVD-checked order)
COLORS = {"up": "#e34948", "down": "#2a78d6", "ns": "#b9c1c6"}
GROUP_COLORS = ["#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300"]
INK = "#7a869a"
GRID = "rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.18)"
CONFIG = {"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True}

sig_rule = f"padj &lt; {K['padj_threshold']:g}" + (
    f" and |log2FC| &gt; {K['log2fc_threshold']:g}" if K["log2fc_threshold"] else ""
)


def style(fig, height=340, **layout):
    """Shared layout that reads well in both the light and the dark theme."""
    defaults = dict(
        height=height,
        margin=dict(l=55, r=15, t=15, b=45),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        font=dict(color=INK, size=12),
        hovermode="closest",
        showlegend=False,
    )
    fig.update_layout(**{**defaults, **layout})
    fig.update_xaxes(gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=False, linecolor=GRID)
    fig.update_yaxes(gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=False, linecolor=GRID)
    return fig


def show_fig(fig):
    """Show a figure; plotly.js itself is in the document header (plotly.html)."""
    display(
        HTML(
            fig.to_html(
                full_html=False,
                include_plotlyjs=False,
                include_mathjax=False,
                config=CONFIG,
            )
        )
    )


def group_colors(groups):
    names = list(dict.fromkeys(groups))
    return {g: GROUP_COLORS[i % len(GROUP_COLORS)] for i, g in enumerate(names)}


def hint(text):
    display(HTML(f'<p class="hint">{text}</p>'))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
# Lead sentence, highlight chips and summary tiles
S = D["summary"]
print(
    f'<p class="lead">Across <b>{K["samples"]} samples</b>, <b>{K["genes_quantified"]:,}</b> '
    f"genes were quantified. At {sig_rule}, <b>{K['de_genes']:,}</b> genes are "
    f"differentially expressed ({K['up']:,} up, {K['down']:,} down).</p>"
)
chips = []
if K["de_genes"] and S["top"]:
    chips.append(f"Most significant <b>{S['top']['gene']}</b> padj {S['top']['padj']:.1e}")
if S["strongest"]:
    st = S["strongest"]
    chips.append(
        f"Largest change <b>{st['gene']}</b> log2FC {st['log2fc']:+.2f} "
        f"(mean &ge; {st['min_basemean']:g})"
    )
chips.append(f"PC1 explains <b>{D['pca']['var'][0]}%</b> of variance")
chips.append(f"&asymp; <b>{S['n_nonnull']:,}</b> genes estimated to respond")
print('<div class="highlights">' + "".join(f"<span>{c}</span>" for c in chips) + "</div>")

tiles = "".join(
    f'<div class="kpi{" accent" if t.get("accent") else ""}">'
    f'<div class="kpi-label">{t["l"]}</div><div class="kpi-value">{t["v"]}</div>'
    + (f'<div class="kpi-sub">{t["sub"]}</div>' if t.get("sub") else "")
    + "</div>"
    for t in D["tiles"]
)
print(f'<div class="kpi-grid">{tiles}</div>')
```

## Samples

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .panel}
### Sample similarity (PCA)

```{python}
p = D["pca"]
hint(p["hint"])
colors = group_colors(p["group"])
fig = go.Figure()
for g, color in colors.items():
    idx = [i for i, x in enumerate(p["group"]) if x == g]
    fig.add_scatter(
        x=[p["pc1"][i] for i in idx],
        y=[p["pc2"][i] for i in idx],
        text=[p["sample"][i] for i in idx],
        name=g,
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(size=12, color=color, line=dict(width=1.5, color="white")),
        hovertemplate="<b>%{text}</b><br>" + g + "<br>PC1 %{x}, PC2 %{y}<extra></extra>",
    )
style(
    fig,
    showlegend=True,
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.12, x=0),
    xaxis_title=f"PC1 ({p['var'][0]}%)",
    yaxis_title=f"PC2 ({p['var'][1]}%)",
)
show_fig(fig)
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .panel}
### Sample-to-sample correlation

```{python}
c = D["corr"]
hint("Spearman correlation of the variance-stabilized expression between samples.")
z = np.array(c["z"])
off_diagonal = z[~np.eye(len(z), dtype=bool)]
zmin = max(0.0, np.floor(off_diagonal.min() * 20) / 20 - 0.05) if off_diagonal.size else 0
fig = go.Figure(
    go.Heatmap(
        z=z,
        x=c["labels"],
        y=c["labels"],
        zmin=zmin,
        zmax=1,
        colorscale=[[0, "#f2f6fc"], [0.4, "#bcd6f4"], [0.7, "#5a97e0"], [1, "#1c5cab"]],
        xgap=1,
        ygap=1,
        colorbar=dict(thickness=10, len=0.85),
        hovertemplate="%{y} x %{x}<br>r = %{z}<extra></extra>",
    )
)
style(fig, margin=dict(l=90, r=15, t=15, b=90))
fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", showgrid=False, tickfont=dict(size=9))
fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=-45, showgrid=False, tickfont=dict(size=9))
show_fig(fig)
```

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .panel}
### Volcano plot

```{python}
v = D["volcano"]


def de_traces(x, y, hover):
    traces = []
    for cls, name in [("ns", "n.s."), ("down", "Down"), ("up", "Up")]:
        idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(v["cls"]) if c == cls]
        traces.append(
            go.Scatter(
                x=[x[i] for i in idx],
                y=[y[i] for i in idx],
                text=[v["gene"][i] for i in idx],
                name=name,
                mode="markers",
                marker=dict(
                    size=4 if cls == "ns" else 6,
                    color=COLORS[cls],
                    opacity=0.5 if cls == "ns" else 0.85,
                ),
                hovertemplate=hover,
            )
        )
    return traces


fig = go.Figure(
    de_traces(v["x"], v["y"], "<b>%{text}</b><br>log2FC %{x}<br>-log10 p %{y}<extra></extra>")
)
style(fig, xaxis_title="log2 fold change", yaxis_title="-log10 p-value")
fig.update_xaxes(zeroline=True, zerolinecolor=GRID)
show_fig(fig)
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .panel}
### Fold change vs expression (MA plot)

```{python}
hint("Large fold changes at low expression are the least reliable.")
fig = go.Figure(
    de_traces(
        v["base_mean"], v["x"], "<b>%{text}</b><br>mean %{x:.0f}<br>log2FC %{y}<extra></extra>"
    )
)
style(fig, xaxis_title="mean of normalized counts", yaxis_title="log2 fold change")
fig.update_xaxes(type="log")
fig.update_yaxes(zeroline=True, zerolinecolor=INK)
show_fig(fig)
```

### Top differential genes

```{python}
h = D["heatmap"]
if not h["genes"]:
    hint(f"No significant genes at {sig_rule}.")
else:
    hint(
        "Row-scaled (z-score) variance-stabilized expression of the genes with the "
        "lowest padj, up then down."
    )
    fig = go.Figure(
        go.Heatmap(
            z=h["z"],
            x=h["samples"],
            y=list(range(len(h["genes"]))),
            text=[[g] * len(h["samples"]) for g in h["genes"]],
            zmin=-2,
            zmax=2,
            colorscale=[[0, COLORS["down"]], [0.5, "#eceff4"], [1, COLORS["up"]]],
            xgap=1,
            ygap=1,
            colorbar=dict(thickness=10, len=0.85, title="z"),
            hovertemplate="%{text} in %{x}<br>z = %{z}<extra></extra>",
        )
    )
    style(fig, height=max(340, 16 * len(h["genes"]) + 110), margin=dict(l=90, r=15, t=15, b=90))
    fig.update_yaxes(
        autorange="reversed",
        tickmode="array",
        tickvals=list(range(len(h["genes"]))),
        ticktext=h["genes"],
        showgrid=False,
        tickfont=dict(size=9),
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=-45, showgrid=False, tickfont=dict(size=9))
    show_fig(fig)
```

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .panel}
### Key genes per sample

```{python}
G = D["genes"]
items = G["items"]
if not items:
    hint(f"No key genes: no significant genes at {sig_rule} with a mean of at least the highlight threshold.")
else:
    hint(
        "Normalized counts per sample (log scale)"
        + (f"; lines join samples from the same {G['pair_label']}." if G["pairs"] else ".")
    )
    names = list(dict.fromkeys(G["groups"]))
    colors = group_colors(G["groups"])
    cols = 2 if len(items) > 1 else 1
    rows = int(np.ceil(len(items) / cols))
    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=rows,
        cols=cols,
        subplot_titles=[
            f"<b>{it['gene']}</b>  log2FC {it['log2fc']:+.2f}"
            for it in items
        ],
        horizontal_spacing=0.18,
        vertical_spacing=0.25 if rows > 1 else 0.1,
    )
    for k, it in enumerate(items):
        row, col = k // cols + 1, k % cols + 1
        if G["pairs"]:
            for pair in dict.fromkeys(G["pairs"]):
                idx = [i for i, x in enumerate(G["pairs"]) if x == pair]
                fig.add_scatter(
                    x=[G["groups"][i] for i in idx],
                    y=[it["values"][i] for i in idx],
                    mode="lines",
                    line=dict(width=1.5, color=COLORS["ns"]),
                    hoverinfo="skip",
                    showlegend=False,
                    row=row,
                    col=col,
                )
        for g in names:
            idx = [i for i, x in enumerate(G["groups"]) if x == g]
            fig.add_scatter(
                x=[g] * len(idx),
                y=[it["values"][i] for i in idx],
                text=[G["samples"][i] for i in idx],
                name=g,
                legendgroup=g,
                showlegend=k == 0,
                mode="markers",
                marker=dict(size=10, color=colors[g], line=dict(width=1.5, color="white")),
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{it['gene']}</b> in %{{text}}<br>%{{y:.0f}} normalized counts"
                f"<br>padj {it['padj']:.1e}<extra></extra>",
                row=row,
                col=col,
            )
        fig.update_yaxes(type="log", dtick=1, tickformat="~s", row=row, col=col)
        fig.update_xaxes(
            categoryorder="array",
            categoryarray=names,
            range=[-0.4, len(names) - 0.6],
            tickfont=dict(size=10),
            row=row,
            col=col,
        )
    style(
        fig,
        height=260 * rows + 60,
        showlegend=True,
        legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.12, x=0),
        margin=dict(l=55, r=15, t=40, b=40),
    )
    fig.update_annotations(font_size=11)
    show_fig(fig)
```

## P-value distribution

```{python}
P = D["pvalues"]
hint(
    f"Raw p-values of the {P['n']:,} tested genes. A flat floor means the test is well "
    "calibrated; the spike near 0 is the real signal: about "
    f"<b>{P['n_nonnull']:,}</b> genes ({round((1 - P['pi0']) * 100)}%) are estimated to respond."
)
w = P["bin_width"]
centers = [(i + 0.5) * w for i in range(len(P["counts"]))]
null_level = P["pi0"] * P["n"] * w
fig = go.Figure(
    go.Bar(
        x=centers,
        y=P["counts"],
        width=w * 0.92,
        marker_color="#7C4BAC",
        customdata=[f"{x - w / 2:.3f}-{x + w / 2:.3f}" for x in centers],
        hovertemplate="p %{customdata}<br>%{y} genes<extra></extra>",
    )
)
fig.add_hline(
    y=null_level,
    line=dict(color=INK, width=1.5, dash="dash"),
    annotation_text=f"expected if no gene responded (pi0 = {P['pi0']:.2f})",
    annotation_position="top right",
)
style(fig, height=260, xaxis_title="p-value", yaxis_title="genes")
fig.update_xaxes(range=[0, 1])
show_fig(fig)
```


```{python}
table = pd.DataFrame(D["table"])
if table.empty:
    hint("No tested genes.")
else:
    padj, lfc = K["padj_threshold"], K["log2fc_threshold"]
    table["direction"] = np.where(
        (table["padj"] >= padj) | (table["log2fc"].abs() <= lfc),
        "n.s.",
        np.where(table["log2fc"] > 0, "up", "down"),
    )
    table = table.rename(columns={"log2fc": "log2FoldChange"})[
        ["gene", "gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "direction"]
    ]
    show(
        table,
        order=[[5, "asc"]],
        pageLength=15,
        buttons=["pageLength", "csvHtml5"],
        classes="display compact",
        showIndex=False,
    )
```
